_comment: Machine-readable twin of docs/geography-definition.md. The site reads county names ONLY from this file — CLAUDE.md rule 2 forbids hardcoding them anywhere else. scripts/validate.mjs checks this file against the doc and fails if they drift. Unlike organizations.json this file has nothing to sanitize, so there is no separate working copy: it lives here and ships as-is.
status: PROVISIONAL — the county list was drafted by us, not supplied by the project lead. Pending her sign-off.

tiers.label: Counties next to Mecklenburg
tiers.note: The six counties that physically border Mecklenburg.

tier_captions.statewide: Statewide and national services — no office to visit, usable from anywhere in North Carolina
tier_captions.travel: Worth the journey — these require significant travel
tier_captions.elsewhere: Outside the region, kept because they may still take a referral from here

unlisted_counties_note: service_area.counties also contains Anson, Montgomery, Richmond, Forsyth, Wake, Guilford and New Hanover, which are not in the working list. Anson and Montgomery are part of the NC DSB Charlotte district's real catchment. geoRank() falls back to service_area.verdict for any county it does not recognise, so an unlisted county never demotes an in_area record. scripts/validate.mjs warns about these so the project lead can rule on them.
